title: Resident Engineer (Civil)
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a senior Resident Engineer (Civil) to lead our project site team, supervise construction activities, and direct overall site supervision ensuring full compliance with specifications,

budgets, and engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead, direct, and supervise the site engineering and inspection team across all daily operations.

• Review, audit, and approve contractor method statements, shop drawings, submittals, and payment requests.

• Conduct regular progress meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to resolve field issues.

• Enforce full compliance with building codes, technical specifications, QA/QC standards, and HSE guidelines.

• Manage project delivery milestones, monitor schedule variances, assess change orders, and oversee final handover.

Requirements & Qualifications:

* B.Sc. in Civil Engineering from an accredited university.
* Minimum 15 years of proven experience in construction supervision and site management.
* Valid Driver's License (Mandatory).
* Proven leadership record managing major projects as Resident Engineer.
* Strong command of FIDIC contract administration and technical specifications.
* Required Education: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering
* Required Experience: Minimum 15 Years of experience in civil site supervision
* Driving License Requirement: Valid Driver's License (Mandatory)

How to Apply (LinkedIn):

Please send your updated CV to Admin@alburj.net with the subject line:

Application - Resident Engineer (Civil) - R.E. Immediate joiners preferred.
